assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Convex equiangular 12-gon (bold outline) built from a central regular hexagon, six 1 by root 3 rectangles on its sides and six equilateral triangles in the gaps. Black lines bound these pieces and the hexagon's six central triangles; red segments (rectangle diagonals, altitudes of the central and gap triangles) cut everything into 30-60-90 triangles. A blue arc marks one 150 degree angle of the 12-gon.

difficulty_rationale: A meaningful insight or a moderately demanding combination of familiar ideas.
